question: Who among the following became the first woman Chief Executive and Chairperson of the Railway Board on 1 September 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jaya Varma Sinha**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Jaya Varma Sinha** became the first woman Chief Executive and Chairperson of the Railway Board on 1 September 2023.
 
• The Railway Board is the apex body of the Indian Railways and is responsible for its overall management and administration.
